What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude

Do you have experience working with fabrics and know how to identify different pattern pieces? For a garment manufacturing company in the Tielt region, we are looking for someone to prepare fabrics for the cutting process and correctly sort the cut pattern pieces.

• You set up the machine and monitor the automatic unrolling and layering of the fabric.

• You take into account the fabric direction, warp and weft when preparing the materials

• You identify weaving defects and other irregularities and position the fabric in such a way that defective sections do not end up in the finished garments

• You check that the fabrics are correctly prepared and ready for the cutting machine.

• You collect the cut pieces and sort them according to the correct pattern.

• You group components such as sleeves, collars, front panels and back panels so they can be processed together in the next production stage.

• You follow the production schedule and ensure that the work progresses smoothly and efficiently.

 

• You have knowledge of fabrics and textiles, preferably gained through experience in a garment workshop or textile company.

• You can identify different garment components and pattern pieces.

• You can recognise fabric defects and know how to take them into account when laying out the fabric.

• You work accurately while maintaining a good production pace.

• You can count correctly and distinguish between colours, sizes and quantities.

• You have a sufficient understanding of Dutch to correctly interpret work instructions, numbers and labels. Knowledge of English is also an advantage.

• You are physically fit for the job and can work both independently and as part of a team.

• Sewing skills are not required. However, it is important that you can recognise fabrics and the different components of a garment.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver | Full-Time | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
As a CE Truck Driver, you start your day from the company's site in Horebeke with a refrigerated truck loaded with fresh potato products. You'll follow a planned route and deliver goods to distribution centres, wholesalers and retail customers, making for an average of about 8 stops per day. As a CE Truck Driver, you are responsible for checking delivery documents, ensuring accurate deliveries and handling products with care. Loading and unloading is mainly done using an electric pallet truck, limiting heavy physical work. There’s occasional work on Saturdays, between 8 AM. and 5 PM, in which case you get a day off during the week. You work independently, take pride in maintaining your vehicle and follow a schedule that is communicated in advance.

 
We are looking for a CE Truck Driver who combines professionalism with a customer-oriented mindset. The ideal CE Truck Driver has:

 
• A valid CE driving license with a valid code 95 certification.
 
• Previous experience as a CE driver.
 
• Good communication skills in English, additional language skills are considered a plus.
 
• A responsible and independent attitude.
 
• A customer-friendly and professional approach.
 
• Flexibility regarding working hours when needed.
 
• Respect for safety procedures and company equipment.

jobs.occupation: Senior Test Manager - AI-Assisted Testing - Brussels
jobs.description:
Location: Brussels, Belgium

Duration: 12 months, renewable

Working arrangement: Hybrid - 2 days/week on-site after onboarding.
About the company
Our client is a leading Belgian company operating in the financial services sector, offering a wide range of solutions and services.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation, the company is looking for a Senior Test Manager to lead and coordinate testing activities within its Application team.
About the role
You will coordinate testing activities and guide a team of Test Analysts, ensuring quality, efficiency and successful project delivery.

Your main responsibilities will include:

* Coordinating testing activities across different projects.

* Defining and overseeing test strategies, plans and execution.

* Working closely with Business Analysts, IT teams and other stakeholders.

* Managing priorities, resources, deadlines and testing risks.

* Following up on test execution, defects and delivery progress.

* Remaining hands-on and supporting the team beyond reporting and coordination.

* Promoting the use of AI to improve test planning, test case generation and overall testing efficiency.

* Guiding team members in the effective use of AI and sharing your expertise across the team.
The ideal candidate

* Proven experience as a Senior Test Manager or in a similar role.

* Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools and best practices.

* Experience working with cross-functional teams.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Strong delivery mindset and ability to manage challenging deadlines.

* Hands-on approach, with the ability to get involved in operational testing activities.

* Mandatory: Proven hands-on experience using AI in real testing activities and projects.

* Ability to translate AI knowledge into practical testing approaches and coach team members.

* ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or higher) is mandatory.

* Good command of English and at least one Belgian national language (French or Dutch) trilingualism is a strong advantage.

Experience in test automation is a plus, but practical AI experience is the priority.

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

As a Technical Support Officer, you will become part of a close-knit team, supporting customers with high-quality software solutions for the medical sector. You'll benefit from a comprehensive training programme and plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

Your responsibilities as a Technical Support Officer:

As a Technical Support Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers who need technical assistance. You primarily support French-speaking customers, while also communicating regularly in English with colleagues and customers from other countries.

• Provide technical support to customers regarding software, hardware, and connectivity issues.
• Assist customers via phone, email, and remote support, primarily in French.
• Analyse technical issues and work together with customers to find the most suitable solution.
• Guide customers through software installations, updates, and configurations.
• Accurately register and follow up on support requests in the CRM system.

• You have initial experience in Technical Support, Customer Support, or an IT Help Desk role.

• You are fluent in both French and English, both spoken and written, as you will use these languages daily when communicating with customers and colleagues.
• You are solution-oriented and remain organised when dealing with multiple requests at the same time.

• A secondary education diploma (A2 level) is sufficient. Above all, we value your motivation, eagerness to learn, and passion for technology.

Brusketta is a Neapolitan restaurant on Jan van Rijswijcklaan in Antwerp, known for its energetic, always-busy atmosphere. We’re looking for a Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example, keeps a busy room running smoothly and makes every guest feel looked after.

• Lead the floor during service: divide tasks, keep the pace and motivate the team 

• Keep communication between floor, bar and kitchen clear 

• Solve problems calmly before guests notice them

Who you are
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A strong service mindset with natural leadership qualities 

• Energized by a busy restaurant, organized and hands-on 

• English and basic Dutch required; Italian or French is a plus  

What we offer
 
 

• Full-time contract, 38 hours per week 

• €16–€18 brutto per hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay and a 13th month

• 2 days off per week  

• Real responsibility from day one in a growing restaurant group  

 Send your CV, a photo and a short introduction to
